name: qkd_kvs_attn_rv3-rv3-56f49b294
purpose: SAFE ATTN rv (KV-ATTN2 10-19, tree K.STA.ATTN): structural redesign of the core TT -569 ps / upstream 816 ps cone -- the RX record check (493-bit zero test + expectation compare + direction + time) is REGISTERED flop->flop one edge after the landing (qkd_native_attention_record_rv), the admission request leaves the controller as 10 kept register copies (root accept slices <= 36 flops), issue / load / status_slot / calendar strobes are kept copies (<= 32 loads), the result face captures its 512-bit beat unconditionally (no fin[0] enable), RX zero flags only from the landed copy, fault-root ufk pins land per pin; reset landed by the kit (balanced 2-stage, 2 first / 48 final kept copies, <= 32 reset loads per copy). ADDED: +1 edge K.rx_record (every RX observation, root/face/RESULT/STATUS/prg/arh +1, calendar TX_SHIFT 1: tx_first 1751 / end 1785), priced in lanes/KV-GEN9.md. Pair lockstep vs ba5 (B = A + 1 edge, 11 modes, 155,024 checks) PASS; mutants 1-7 FAIL. r16 SUCCESSOR of rv1/rv2 (same function/edges/pair bench): every kept-copy family re-cut to <= 16 flops per copy (<= ~32 terminal pins), run landing copies, root running copy, unconditional face calendar pipe, guard accept enable over kept valid copies, producer tag capture without the fault term. KV-HEALTH/KV-RETIRE release timing: RETIRE_STATIC=1, STATUS_DELAY=213 (STATUS at compiled_end-1 = 1998 relative to the link law; end = tx_first+34+213).
